title: Motorhome & RV Roof AC Cover 80 × 80 × 38 cm – Protection Between Trips
seo_title: Roof AC Cover for Motorhome 80 × 80 × 38 cm – Black
seo_description: Cover for a motorhome roof AC in black fabric, 80 × 80 × 38 cm, with a drawstring on the lower edge. Keeps rain and debris away between trips.
descriptionHtml:
The rain and tree sap that already settle on the roof AC

The motorhome's roof AC sits exposed at the very top between every trip – rain, tree sap and debris settle directly on the housing while the motorhome is parked, whether it has been a week or a whole season.

A cover in the right size – 80 × 80 × 38 cm

The black fabric cover goes over the roof AC and covers it in height, width and depth. The drawstring on the lower edge is pulled tight so the cover stays put between trips.

Features

  • Rain and debris land on the cover, not on the AC – a full-coverage cover goes directly over the whole unit.
  • Fits roof ACs up to 80 × 80 × 38 cm – the cover's length, width and height.
  • Stays put between trips – the drawstring on the lower edge is pulled tight around the edge of the cover.
  • Discreet black color on the roof – the cover is sewn from black fabric.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The roof AC is not included, only the cover.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
